newsitem.title: CHINA: Aon Corp opens China representative office.
newsitem.headline: Aon Corp opens China representative office.

text.p: U.S.-based insurer Aon Corp has opened a representative office in the Chinese capital, the China Daily said on Thursday.

"We are cooperating closely with Chinese counterparts as they seek to expand insurance services and provide more expertise to the Chinese market," the newspaper quoted Aon's chief representative in Beijing David Liu as saying.
More than 180 foreign insurance firms, eager to tap into a huge and potentially lucrative market, have opened representative offices in China.
Only two foreign insurers, American International Group Inc and Tokio Marine and Fire Insurance Co Ltd, have been allowed to issue policies.
A Hong Kong unit of Manufacturers Life Insurance Co of Canada is setting up China's first life insurance joint venture, Zhang Hong Life Insurance Co.
